summary: Matomo is an open-source web analytics platform designed as a self-hosted alternative to Google Analytics. It tracks visitor traffic, page views, and user behaviour while aiming to keep all data under your direct control to protect user privacy.
goodFor: This is a strong fit if you require detailed usage statistics for your websites but must comply with strict privacy regulations by keeping analytics data on your own infrastructure.
watchOut: Self-hosting an analytics platform can generate significant database storage over time, requiring you to manage data archiving, table optimisation, and regular maintenance tasks yourself.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a web server like Nginx or Apache, along with a persistent relational database such as MySQL or MariaDB to store the captured telemetry.
